source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 23 iulie — «Sfinţii Mucenici Trofim şi Teofil»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 21ης Ιουλίου — «Άγιοι Θεόφιλος, Τρόφιμος και άλλοι Δεκατρείς Μάρτυρες»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 21 Ιουλίου εκάστου έτους». The Greek calendar keeps the company on 21 Ιουλίου and the Romanian row this folder already carries keeps it on 23 iulie — a different day on a different calendar, and the Greek listing for 23 Ιουλίου does not name them. The men are the folder's own: the thirteen companions counted and unnamed, the reign of Diocletian, the stoning, the iron instruments, the burning of the wounds and the beheading, which is the passion doxologia tells. The page gives the reign in years, «(284 - 304 μ.Χ.)», and that is taken into `dates`. Its verse for Trophimus — «Tρισκαίδεκα Tρόφιμος άνδρας συντρόφους, Έχων συνάθλους τέμνεται τούτοις άμα» — counts the thirteen again and still names none, so they get no folder. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence. The page prints no hymn.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).

death.note: saint.gr: «Οι άγιοι αυτοί, έζησαν στα χρόνια του αυτοκράτορα Διοκλητιανού (284 - 304 μ.Χ.)». The interval is that reign as the page prints it, which ends the reign in 304 where it is usually given as 305. The Romanian source the folder was built from named the reign and gave no years.
